verdict.rationale: Codex ships a documented meta-skill (`@plugin-creator`) that scaffolds the `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` manifest and wires MCP, a `SKILL.md` spec with required fields, a `$skill-installer` for packaging/distribution, and even a recorder that drafts a skill from a demonstration — all first-party documented and confirmed by a real keyless probe installing `plugin-creator` as a portable skill folder. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on account of a full author-to-package workflow (only installer usage is community-attested) and more detail on marketplace publishing beyond local testing.
